name: File Store Bot
description: Telegram file store bot by Trinity Mods — private share links, 0-4 force-sub channels, referral & dual access modes, start image, shortener earnings, auto-delete and premium.

CHANNEL_ID.description: ID of your private database channel (starts with -100). Make the bot an admin there.

OWNER_TAG.description: Your public Telegram username without @ (shown to users for support & payments).

ADMINS.description: Extra admin user IDs separated by spaces (the owner is always an admin).

ACCESS_MODE.description: How users unlock files: fsub (join channels), referral (invite users), dual (join channels, then invite) or off.

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Force-sub chat 1 — channel/group ID (-100...) or @username. Leave empty to skip. The bot must be admin there.

REFERRAL_COUNT.description: Referral / dual mode: how many NEW users someone must invite to unlock files.

REFERRAL_EXPIRE.description: Referral / dual mode: seconds files stay unlocked after reaching the goal (0 = forever).

START_PIC.description: Image sent with the start message — a direct image link, a Telegram file_id or a repo path like assets/start.jpg. Leave empty for none.

FORCE_PIC.description: Optional image for the force-sub message.

REFERRAL_PIC.description: Optional image for the referral screen.

TIME.description: Delete delivered files after this many seconds (0 = never).

PROTECT_CONTENT.description: TRUE stops users from forwarding or saving delivered files.

DISABLE_CHANNEL_BUTTON.description: TRUE = no 'Share URL' button under posts in the database channel.

USE_SHORTLINK.description: TRUE to earn with a URL shortener.

U_S_E_P.description: TRUE = every link goes through the shortener. FALSE = users verify a token once every VERIFY_EXPIRE seconds.

VERIFY_EXPIRE.description: Seconds a verified token stays valid (43200 = 12 hours).

TUT_VID.description: Tutorial link showing users how to pass your shortener.

USE_PAYMENT.description: TRUE shows premium plans (works with USE_SHORTLINK). Premium users skip the shortener and referrals.

UPI_ID.description: Your UPI ID for premium payments.

UPI_IMAGE_URL.description: Direct link to your UPI QR code image.
